display.purpose: Content-page headings (.section__heading) and the compact header's page title (.hero__pagetitle h1) — weight 900 with 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1 variation. Headings-only face; never body/label/UI. Also the Variety Show headliner payload (.headliner__teaser em/strong) in violet-800 — italic 500 while unannounced, upright 900 once revealed — so it never duplicates the ink section heading above it.

theme-display.purpose: The landing page's Mahiwagahan heading only (.section__heading--theme), clamp(2.75rem, 8vw, 6rem) — floor lowered from 3.25rem so the word fits a ~320px column. A deliberately oversized Display variant reserved for the site's one identity-defining moment. Not reused elsewhere.

numeral.purpose: Agenda page's giant tabular-numeral day-of-month figures (16/17/18); Past FACTs' year figures reuse the same device at a smaller scale (clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem)).

title.purpose: Workshops session titles (.workshop__title), weight 800, one step below Display; also the Variety Show headliner slot name (.headliner__label).

category-label.purpose: One class, .groupheading, weight 700 in --accent-on-light: FAQ categories, Workshop sessions, Team committees, Palengke vendor categories, and Variety Show Dance/Music groups. The same step also sets Variety Show act names (.act__name) and ticket-path labels (.vshow__path dt).

quote.purpose: About page's pulled quote; Past FACTs theme names (.pastfacts__theme) reuse the same italic Fraunces device for a pulled-phrase feel.

lead.purpose: About page's opening sentence, weight 400, ink-900; also the Variety Show show-facts line (.vshow__facts, Jost 500).

body.purpose: About paragraph copy, FAQ answers, Workshops descriptions, Palengke vendor themes, and Variety Show act blurbs (1.02rem, 65ch max), set in --ink-on-light-dim.

structural-label.purpose: Agenda weekday labels, TOC index numerals, cross-link strip label, set in --accent-on-light; Team role labels (.team__role) reuse the same uppercase compact-label device.

nav-link.purpose: Primary nav items (About, Workshops, Team, Past FACTs, Variety Show, FAQ) — inline at >=900px, inside the .hero__menu drawer below. 0.92rem.

label.purpose: Night-band pill button text, and the .hero__navtoggle-label current-page/'Menu' text, unchanged size/weight.

meta.purpose: Night-band topbar eventline and countdown label; Palengke's .vendor__handle (0.8rem, --accent-on-light) reuses this size step.

shadows.name: footer-mark-shadow
shadows.purpose: Footer's circular photo mark — the one carried-over ambient shadow on the day band's dark bookend.

shadows.name: placeholder-circle-shadow
shadows.purpose: Shared shadow on the radial-gradient placeholder circle device: Team member avatars, Past FACTs photo placeholders, and Palengke vendor logos (.vendor__logo) all reuse this exact value.

shadows.name: pill-ink-shadow
shadows.purpose: The .pill--ink variant's resting shadow — soft and diffuse, matching the system's no-hard-offset rule.

shadows.name: vendor-card-shadow
shadows.purpose: Palengke pass. .vendor__card's shadow — the first shadow in the system used to bound a rectangular content block rather than a circular device or pill. The confirmed, user-chosen exception to the No-Card Rule; stays soft/diffuse, no hard offset, no border-radius.

shadows.name: cta-icon-glow
shadows.purpose: New this pass. Outer glow on the Newsletter CTA's seal icon (.cta__icon), on top of the standard placeholder-circle-shadow. The first icon-level glow in the system; reserved for a section's single deliberate focal icon, not applied to every placeholder circle.

shadows.name: photoframe-shadow
shadows.purpose: Real-photography pass. .photoframe (Venue) and .photocarousel__track/.photocarousel__nav (About carousel) all reuse this exact ambient shadow value, carried over from the retired placeholder device rather than inventing a new one.

shadows.name: photo-frame-shadow
shadows.purpose: Team member photos (.team__photo) and Variety Show act frames (.act__photo): 8px-rounded photographic frames on the parchment band.

shadows.name: headliner-photo-shadow
shadows.purpose: The revealed Variety Show headliner photo frame only — a deeper lift than act frames because it is the lineup's single focal object.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus transitions across both bands, the .hero__menu drawer's open/close transition, and (new this pass) the theme heading's pointer-tilt/glow transition and the CTA seal-stamp entrance keyframe.

motion.name: seal-stamp
motion.value: @keyframes, 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo), scale(0.45) rotate(-14deg) -> scale(1.05) rotate(3deg) -> scale(1) rotate(0deg), opacity 0->1
motion.purpose: New this pass. One-shot scroll-triggered entrance for a section's focal seal icon — currently the only member is .cta__icon; the retired TOC section's .toc__visual selector was removed in a follow-up polish pass. Armed via IntersectionObserver + a .js-seal-armed class on <html>; progressive-enhancement-safe; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: theme-twinkle
motion.value: @keyframes, 2.6s ease-in-out infinite, opacity 0.18<->0.85, scale 0.75<->1.15, staggered 0.4s-1.8s per sparkle
motion.purpose: New this pass. Idle twinkle loop for the five .theme__sparkle glyphs around the landing page's Mahiwagahan heading, once visible.

motion.name: act-about-in
motion.purpose: Variety Show act details appearing when an act's More toggle opens; off under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile-nav
breakpoints.purpose: This pass: the docked .hero__menu drawer expands to a full-bleed sheet — no longer 'collapses to hamburger' from an inline link row, since the always-visible trigger + drawer pattern is now the nav at every width. Also: About/Agenda grids collapse to one column; the four corner motifs switch to fixed mobile pixel sizes; Workshops rows stack to a single column; Past FACTs entries top-align and shrink their photo circle from 110px to 76px. Palengke's .vendor__grid has no dedicated rule at this breakpoint — it reflows via its own auto-fill track.

breakpoints.name: topbar-wrap
breakpoints.purpose: Night band: topbar eventline wraps. Unchanged.

breakpoints.name: faq-compact
breakpoints.purpose: FAQ summary shrinks; TOC arrow hides and entries top-align; cross-link strip stacks vertically. Variety Show: act grid drops to two per row, an opened act stacks photo over text, ticket-path rows stack, and the show-facts list stacks without separators.

components.name: Content Section Heading
components.description: Load-bearing heading pattern on every page: a Fraunces 900 heading (SOFT 40/WONK 1) with a short orchid accent rule beneath it. Reused verbatim by Workshops, Team, Past FACTs, and Palengke.
components.css: .ds-section-inner { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-section-heading { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4rem); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0e155e; } .ds-section-rule { width: 64px; height: 2px; margin: 1.5rem 0 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #b37ad4, rgba(179,122,212,0)); }

components.name: Theme Moment (landing page)
components.description: New this pass. The landing page's dedicated identity beat: the oversized Mahiwagahan heading (Theme Display role) centered on its own, surrounded by five twinkling sparkle glyphs, with an optional pointer-tilt/glow interaction on fine-pointer devices without prefers-reduced-motion. Below it, an italic-Fraunces definition line reuses the Quote role at a heavier weight.
components.css: .ds-theme-heading { margin: 0; text-align: center; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-size: clamp(3.25rem, 8vw, 6rem); letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: #4b1c71; } .ds-theme-definition { margin: 1.25rem auto 0; max-width: 40ch; text-align: center; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.9vw, 1.6rem); line-height: 1.4; color: #0e155e; }

components.name: Venue Block (landing page)
components.description: Two-column where/when section: date label + heading + description + About-link button on the left, a real photo in a .photoframe (21/9, hard-edged, ambient shadow) on the right.
components.html:
Oct. 16–18, 2026

University of Illinois Urbana–Champaign

FACT — Filipinx Americans Coming Together — is three days on campus: workshops, culture, and community.

About FACT 2026
components.css: .ds-venue { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem); align-items: center; } .ds-venue-label { margin: 0; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4b1c71; } .ds-venue-heading { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.2vw, 2.25rem); line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0e155e; } .ds-venue-text { margin: 1rem 0 0; max-width: 44ch; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(14,21,94,0.72); }

components.name: Quick Facts Stat Band (landing page, rebuilt)
components.description: Rebuilt this pass from a parchment three-column row into a full-bleed dark ink-900 stat band, echoing the footer's dark passage. Three items, no icons — pure numeral + label typography.
components.html:
Oct 16–18

2026 Dates
components.css: .ds-quickfacts-band { background: #0e155e; padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 4.5rem) clamp(1.25rem, 6vw, 5rem); } .ds-quickfacts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); } .ds-quickfacts-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; } .ds-quickfacts-value { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); line-height: 1; color: #b37ad4; } .ds-quickfacts-label { margin: 0.65rem 0 0; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); }

components.name: Newsletter CTA (landing page)
components.description: New this pass. The landing page's closing conversion section: a glowing seal icon with scroll-triggered entrance, heading, rule, supporting text, and a live mailto pill button. Bounded by orchid-tinted hairlines top and bottom, separate section per explicit no-card direction.
components.html:
Ready for FACT 2026?

Registration opens soon — join our newsletter to be the first to know.

Join the Newsletter
components.css: .ds-cta-section { text-align: center; border-top: 1px solid rgba(179,122,212,0.3); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(179,122,212,0.3); } .ds-cta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-cta-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #b37ad4, #4b1c71 55%, #0e155e 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(6,4,30,0.28), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.22); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 14px rgba(179,122,212,0.55)); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-cta-heading { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4rem); color: #4b1c71; } .ds-cta-text { margin: 1.25rem 0 0; max-width: 44ch; font-size: 1.05rem; color: rgba(14,21,94,0.72); }

components.name: Group Heading (Workshops sessions, Team committees, Palengke vendor categories)
components.description: Generic class (.groupheading) for a subheading pattern that groups related entries. Visually and numerically identical to the pre-existing .faq__categoryheading; both class names currently exist in sections.css for the same computed style. Documented as a known duplication, not a two-pattern system.
components.css: .ds-groupheading { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.9vw, 1.5rem); letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: #4b1c71; }

components.name: Vendor Card
components.description: New this pass. The site's one confirmed, user-chosen exception to the No-Card Rule: a flat white block with a soft diffuse shadow, hard-edged (no border-radius), used only for the Palengke vendor grid — a set of distinct, comparable entities. Reuses the standing radial-gradient placeholder-circle device for the logo, and the standing name/body-ink/accent typography roles for its text; nothing new was introduced beyond the container treatment itself.
components.html:
• Lumpia & Turon Cart

    Crispy lumpia and turon, fried to order.

    Instagram handle: TBD
components.css: .ds-vendor-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.85rem; padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 1.85rem); background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(14,21,94,0.12), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(14,21,94,0.14); list-style: none; } .ds-vendor-logo { flex: none; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #b37ad4, #4b1c71 55%, #0e155e 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(6,4,30,0.28), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.22); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); } .ds-vendor-logo svg { width: 46%; height: 46%; } .ds-vendor-name { margin: 0; font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0e155e; } .ds-vendor-theme { margin: 0; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.55; color: rgba(14,21,94,0.72); } .ds-vendor-handle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; margin-top: 0.15rem; font-family: 'Jost', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #4b1c71; }

components.name: Navigation (inline at >=900px, drawer below)
components.description: Six live links (About, Workshops, Team, Past FACTs, Variety Show, FAQ) inline in the topbar at >=900px; below 900px the .hero__navtoggle opens the anchored .hero__menu drawer (toggle click, outside click, Escape close it). The current page carries aria-current. Login (/my-fact/login, ghost pill) and Donate (/donate, solid pill) are live links. Launch-gated controls, when any exist, use aria-disabled + title + .sr-only reason + the live announcer.
components.html:

  • Variety Show

LoginDonate
components.css: .ds-hero-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-navtoggle { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; height: 44px; padding: 0 1.1rem 0 0.9rem; border: none; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-navtoggle-bars { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-navtoggle-bars span { display: block; width: 16px; height: 2px; background: #fff; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-navtoggle-label { font-family: 'Jost', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; } .ds-hero-menu { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 0.6rem); right: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.35rem; min-width: 240px; padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.65rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); background: rgba(10,8,36,0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(6,4,30,0.4); } .ds-hero-links { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-hero-links a { color: #fff; } .ds-hero-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.65rem; padding-top: 1.1rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-hero-menu { left: 0; right: 0; top: 100%; min-width: 0; border-left: none; border-right: none; border-top: none; } }

components.name: Pill — Ink variant
components.description: Third pill variant for interactive buttons placed directly on the parchment day band (Workshops 'Register', Past FACTs 'View Booklet'). The incumbent pill--solid/pill--ghost variants assume a dark surface behind them; pill--ink is a solid violet-to-ink gradient with cream text, tuned for the cream ground instead.
components.css: .ds-pill-ink { position: relative; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Jost', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 0.9rem 1.35rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #4b1c71 0%, #0e155e 100%); color: #ffffdd; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.18), 0 4px 16px rgba(14,21,94,0.28); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill-ink:hover, .ds-pill-ink:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(6,4,30,0.35); }

components.name: Workshop Row
components.description: Hairline-topped row for a single workshop session: title + description on the left, browse-only (no per-row CTA). Same rhythm as Agenda/FAQ rows. Stacks to a single column under 900px.
components.html:
Owning Your Narrative

A storytelling workshop on how personal and cultural history shapes the leader you're becoming.
components.css: .ds-workshop-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem); padding: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem) 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(14,21,94,0.14); } .ds-workshop-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-workshop-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.2vw, 1.75rem); color: #0e155e; } .ds-workshop-desc { margin: 0.6rem 0 0; max-width: 58ch; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.65; color: rgba(14,21,94,0.72); } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-workshop-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1.1rem; } }

components.name: Team Member
components.description: A single team-roster entry: a 68px placeholder-avatar circle (reuses the nav-badge/footer-mark radial-gradient device with a letter initial), a name (dim italic when the name is TBD), and an uppercase role label. Grouped by real committee structure under a .groupheading.
components.css: .ds-team-member { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.85rem; } .ds-team-avatar { width: 68px; height: 68px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #b37ad4, #4b1c71 55%, #0e155e 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(6,4,30,0.28), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.22); font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-team-name { margin: 0; font-size: 1.02rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0e155e; } .ds-team-name-tbd { font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(14,21,94,0.72); } .ds-team-role { margin: 0; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4b1c71; }

components.name: Past FACTs Entry
components.description: Hairline-topped row for one past conference year: a placeholder-photo circle (radial-gradient device with a monoline camera-icon SVG), a Fraunces-900 year numeral, an italic Fraunces theme name, a placeholder flag note, and a pill--ink 'View Booklet' button.
components.html:
2025

"Ipahayag nang Malakas" — Proclaim Loudly

Photos and booklet coming soon
components.css: .ds-pastfacts-entry { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem); padding: clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 3.25rem) 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(14,21,94,0.14); } .ds-pastfacts-photo { flex: none; width: 110px; height: 110px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #b37ad4, #4b1c71 55%, #0e155e 100%); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(6,4,30,0.28), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.22); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); } .ds-pastfacts-photo svg { width: 40%; height: 40%; } .ds-pastfacts-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-pastfacts-year { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem); line-height: 1; color: #0e155e; } .ds-pastfacts-theme { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1.8vw, 1.4rem); color: #0e155e; } .ds-pastfacts-flag { display: block; margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #4b1c71; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-pastfacts-entry { align-items: flex-start; } .ds-pastfacts-photo { width: 76px; height: 76px; } }

components.name: Compact Header Page Title
components.description: Interior-page header block (.hero--compact .hero__pagetitle): a Fraunces 900 <h1> at Display scale plus a one-line dim subtitle, over the collapsed full hero. Unchanged; reused as-is by Workshops, Team, Past FACTs, and Palengke.
components.html:
Palengke

FACT's cultural night market — food, crafts, and community, right on campus.
components.css: .ds-hero-compact { position: relative; min-height: 0; } .ds-hero-compact .ds-hero-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(6,4,22,0.72) 0%, rgba(6,4,22,0.6) 45%, rgba(6,4,22,0.82) 100%); } .ds-hero-pagetitle { position: relative; z-index: 2; padding: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.5rem) clamp(1.25rem, 6vw, 5rem) clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem); } .ds-hero-pagetitle h1 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 900; font-variation-settings: 'SOFT' 40, 'WONK' 1; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4rem); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(4,2,20,0.4); } .ds-hero-pagetitle p { margin: 0.85rem 0 0; max-width: 46ch; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); font-size: 1.02rem; }

components.name: Footer (dark bookend)
components.description: Centered footer, filled with an explicit ink-900 background — reads as a deliberate dark bookend after the parchment day band. Unchanged; identical on all seven pages.
components.html:
FACT 2026 · Mahiwagahan

components.css: .ds-footer { background: #0e155e; padding: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 4.5rem) clamp(1.25rem, 6vw, 5rem) clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-footer-inner { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; gap: 0.85rem; } .ds-footer-mark { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(6,4,30,0.4); display: block; } .ds-footer-mark img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-footer-line { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); } .ds-footer-social { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 0.3rem 0; transition: color 0.25s ease; } .ds-footer-social:hover, .ds-footer-social:focus-visible { color: #b37ad4; } .ds-footer-legal { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-size: 0.78rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }

components.name: FAQ Accordion Item
components.description: Native <details>/<summary> disclosure. Unchanged by this pass.
components.html:
I am a minor, can I go to FACT?

Due to university policies, minors unattended by guardians are not permitted.

narrative.overview: **Status note (2026-09-28):** the pass-by-pass history below describes launch-gated nav links and locked Login/Donate pills. That's no longer the live state. `src/components/site/SiteHeader.tsx` now links About, Workshops, Team, Past FACTs, and Variety Show in the primary nav, and the Login (`/my-fact/login`) and Donate (`/donate`) pills are live links rather than `aria-disabled`. Agenda, Palengke, and FAQ still have routes but aren't in the nav. Variety Show and Donate pages were added after the passes documented here. The `aria-disabled` + live-announcer pattern described below is still the one to use for any future gated control. The site is seven pages deep — Home, About, Agenda, Workshops, Team, Past FACTs, and Palengke, plus FAQ — and all seven run the same night→day→night rhythm: a **night band** (full-bleed violet floral macro photography, reversed-white type, the asset-baked wordmark) opens every page, full-viewport on the landing hero and collapsed to `.hero--compact` on the six interior pages; a **day band** carries all reading content on a warm parchment ground (`--cream-100`, `#ffffdd`) with Fraunces headings, hand-drawn line-art motifs, and the paper-grain texture; a dark `ink-900` footer closes every page as the third bookend. This pass rebuilt the landing page's body content end-to-end, ahead of first deployment. As of this writing, Home, About, and Team are live in the nav; Agenda, Workshops, Past FACTs, Palengke, and FAQ all have real routes and render (some still carry explicit in-page "coming soon" placeholders for content, e.g. Agenda's schedule) but aren't yet linked from the primary nav — see Components → Navigation for the exact gating mechanism. The prior landing build ran hero → an equal-weight three-item quick-facts row → a six-tile table-of-contents grid (one live About tile, five disabled placeholders) → an "Explore FACT 2026" section → a footer CTA. That whole mid-page stack is retired. The rebuilt landing page runs: hero → **Theme moment** (`.section--theme`, new — the Mahiwagahan wordmark and its "Enchanting Our Bright Minds" definition, centered and enlarged to its own dedicated beat with an interactive sparkle/tilt effect) → **Venue** (`.section--venue`, new — a two-column block pairing the Oct. 16–18/UIUC facts and the FACT description with a photo-placeholder device and the site's one live outbound link, "About FACT 2026") → **Quick facts** (`.section--quickfacts`, rebuilt as a full-bleed dark `ink-900` stat band instead of a parchment three-column row) → a single quiet `.landing__soon` line ("More information coming soon," replacing the old TOC grid entirely — About's link now lives in the Venue button instead of being duplicated in a TOC tile) → **Newsletter CTA** (`.section--cta`, new — a centered, hairline-bordered section with a glowing seal icon, "Ready for FACT 2026?", and a live `mailto:` "Join the Newsletter" button) → footer. Every launch-gated nav link (and formerly, TOC tiles) uses `aria-disabled="true"` with a `title="Coming soon"` tooltip and a `.sr-only` reason span; `src/lib/liveSiteInteractions.ts` (the shared interaction logic, ported near-verbatim from an earlier static-site prototype's `main.js` — see implementation note below) now also raises a live screen-reader announcement (`"
keyCharacteristics: Landing page now runs Hero → Theme moment → Venue → Quick facts (dark band) → "More information coming soon" → Newsletter CTA → Footer; the old equal-weight quick-facts row and the six-tile TOC grid are both retired.

The Theme moment (`Mahiwagahan` at `clamp(2.75rem, 8vw, 6rem)`, its own dedicated centered beat) is the system's one intentionally oversized Display variant — bigger than the standard Display role used for every other page's `<h1>`/section heading, reserved for this one identity-defining moment.

Quick facts moved from a parchment three-column row to a full-bleed `ink-900` dark stat band (orchid-400 numerals, dimmed-white labels) — the day band's second dark passage besides the footer, used deliberately as a rhythm break rather than a color slip.

The seal icon (radial-gradient circle, orchid→violet→ink — the same device family as nav badge/footer mark/placeholder avatars) now also anchors the Newsletter CTA, with an added `drop-shadow` glow and a scroll-triggered "seal-stamp" entrance animation (`.js-seal-armed`/`.is-stamped`, IntersectionObserver-driven, progressive-enhancement-safe, honors `prefers-reduced-motion`).

Disabled/launch-gated controls (nav links, Login/Donate pills) now announce their reason to screen readers on activation, not just show it visually via `title`/`.sr-only` — closing a keyboard/AT gap the prior pass left silent.

All placeholder content stays explicitly disclosed in-page (Venue's "Campus photos coming soon," the landing `.landing__soon` line, `.pastfacts__flag`, Palengke's vendor-list intro), never presented as real.
Seven pages, one template family, unchanged: Home (full hero, now with its own richer body) and six interior pages (compact hero + content + crosslink + footer).

The landing page's closing run is now Quick facts (dark band) → "More information coming soon" → **Trailer beat** (`.section--trailer`, its own hairline-bounded section) → Newsletter CTA → Footer; the trailer used to live inside the CTA section, which is now heading → rule → text → button only, restoring its single-purpose intent.
The trailer lightbox is the system's first true modal dialog and the first place `inert` is used to lock background interaction — a pattern any future modal should reuse rather than re-deriving.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Content and controls sit directly on the photograph, a scrim gradient, the parchment ground, or a flat `ink-900` field — never inside a `box-shadow`-bordered container or opaque panel — with exactly one confirmed exception: a grid of distinct, comparable entities (first and so-far-only instance: the Palengke vendor grid, `.vendor__card`), where a flat white block with a soft diffuse shadow is permitted. This pass's `.section--quickfacts` dark band confirms the rule still holds under a color change: it is a full-bleed flat field, not a card or container, exactly like the footer it echoes. The exception was proposed to and chosen by the user directly, and it still may never take a hard-offset shadow, a colored border, or a rounded corner: the binary shape law (Shapes) still applies, hard-edged only, never round.

rules.name: The Hairline-Only Structure Rule
rules.body: Every visual division between content outside the one confirmed card exception is a 1–2px tinted hairline or the short orchid accent rule under a heading. The CTA section is bounded top and bottom by a `1px solid rgba(179, 122, 212, 0.3)` hairline (orchid-400 at 30% alpha) — an orchid-tinted variant of the same hairline device, used because the CTA is a standalone section between two other sections and needed a visible seam without becoming a card.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: On-light text uses exactly two ink roles: solid `ink-900` and `ink-900` at 72% alpha. Orchid/violet stay accent-only. Holds unchanged, including in the new Venue and CTA sections.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Headings-Only Rule
rules.body: Fraunces still appears solely in heading/numeral/quote/title roles, now including Theme Display. `.venue__heading`, `.theme__definition`, and `.quickfacts__value` all extend the rule to their respective roles rather than introducing a new face.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Section headings carry no eyebrow/kicker label above them. `.section--theme`, `.section--venue`, and `.section--cta` all confirm this — the Venue section's `.venue__label` is a value ("Oct. 16–18, 2026"), not an eyebrow above a heading of the same subject; it sits above the `<h2>` because it *is* the date fact, not a category tag.

rules.name: The No Hard Offset Rule
rules.body: Unchanged; the CTA icon's glow and the seal-stamp entrance stay in the same soft/diffuse, non-hard-offset family as every other shadow/effect in the system.

dos: **Do** reserve the Theme Display type role (`clamp(2.75rem, 8vw, 6rem)`) for the landing page's `Mahiwagahan` heading alone; use the standard Display role for every other heading, including other large moments.

**Do** treat the dark `.section--quickfacts` band as a deliberate, occasional rhythm break (like the footer) — not a signal that dark bands are now interchangeable with the parchment day band throughout the site.

**Do** reuse the radial-gradient placeholder-circle/rectangle device for any future placeholder-photo need, including the Venue section's `.about__photo`-class reuse, rather than introducing a fifth placeholder visual.

**Do** keep the `aria-disabled` + `title` + `.sr-only` reason-span + live-announcer pattern uniform across every launch-gated control (nav links and pills alike) — any newly gated control should pick up all four automatically via the existing global selector and CSS class.
**Do** use `.pill--ink` for any interactive pill placed directly on the parchment day band; reserve `.pill--solid`/`.pill--ghost` for pills on a photographic or dark surface.
**Do** flag placeholder content explicitly in-page rather than presenting invented names, numbers, dates, or copy as real.
**Do** reserve the CTA icon's `drop-shadow` glow for a section's single, deliberate focal icon — not a treatment to apply to every placeholder circle or badge.

**Do** keep the seal-stamp entrance animation reserved for a section's own one-shot focal icon moment (currently `.cta__icon` and `.mahiwagahan__icon`); it is not a generic reveal-on-scroll utility for arbitrary content.

**Do** reuse the `inert`-on-background pattern (see Components → Trailer Lightbox) for any future modal, rather than hand-rolling Tab/Shift+Tab interception — it's the only approach that reliably holds when focus can move into a cross-origin iframe.

**Do** keep each section's conversion ask singular — a critique on the trailer's original placement (inside `.section--cta`) is the concrete lesson: a section documented as one standalone moment should not quietly grow a second ask.
donts: **Don't** introduce a card, panel, or opaque-background container for grouping content outside the one confirmed exception (`.vendor__card`).
**Don't** add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading, including the Venue section's date label (it's a fact, not a category tag).
**Don't** author a new placeholder-avatar/photo/logo visual device — reuse the existing radial-gradient circle/rectangle.
**Don't** add hard-offset/neobrutalist shadows anywhere, including the new CTA icon glow or the seal-stamp entrance.

**Don't** reintroduce a TOC-style grid of disabled tiles for launch-gated pages — nav links carrying `aria-disabled` directly, plus one clear live-link button in context (the Venue section's pattern), replaced it and should stay the pattern for any future "not yet live" surface.

**Don't** reintroduce a second class for the same Category Label style — `.groupheading` is the one name; a `.faq__categoryheading` selector existed in this document's history but not in the code, and shouldn't be recreated.
**Don't** reintroduce a two-element, independently-positioned links/actions nav (the retired `top: calc(100% + 168px)` pattern from two passes ago).

**Don't** add a page's link back into the nav before that page is actually live — the nav lists what's real, not what's planned; remove-then-re-add beats disabled-and-shown for this project's launch phase.
